name: Blast Radius Guard — File & Line Expansion Thresholds
description: Implement checkDiffSafety in src/diff-guard.ts that enforces file count and line thresholds and protects sensitive config files.

inputs.task_prompt: Implement checkDiffSafety(files: string[], linesChanged: number) in src/diff-guard.ts: 1) Block if files count > 5. 2) Block if linesChanged > 100. 3) Block if files contains '.env' or 'credentials.json'. Otherwise return { safe: true }. Ensure test/diff-guard.test.ts passes.

acceptance_criteria: checkDiffSafety blocks changes with > 100 lines changed
checkDiffSafety blocks changes modifying .env or credentials.json
